prompts.prompt:
Create an exceptional high-budget-looking PC typing roguelike BATTLE UI art direction keyframe, 16:9 landscape, ideally 2560x1440 or larger. Single actual game screen, ENGLISH LOCALIZATION, not a collage, not a browser dashboard. ORIGINAL design, no existing game character or logo copying. World: contemporary developed hell, stylish modern anime jailer women employed by an ominous afterlife administration, urban brutalist infrastructure and supernatural soul processing. Absolutely NO feudal Japan, lanterns, samurai, scrolls, paper charms, calligraphy, pagodas, medieval fantasy borders. Do not reference previous generated images or existing project parts.
ART DIRECTION: "AFTERLIFE / BLACK ENAMEL". Bespoke premium industrial-ritual interface. Black ceramic enamel instruments, smoked optical glass recessed into graphite housings, precise thin cool titanium machined edges, deep oxblood inset material and vivid vermilion warning lamps. Warm porcelain typography. Restrained but unmistakable PHYSICAL DEPTH: single upper-left light source, micro edge highlights, delicate cast contact shadows, bevels only 1-2px at implied 1080 resolution, dark recessed channels, visible thin side-wall thickness on raised panels, slight surface roughness, selective tiny abrasion at outer corners. Dark panels must have volume and differentiated planes, NOT uniform black rectangles with gold strokes. No ornate gold, no HUD neon cyan everywhere, no skeleton clip art decoration, no plastic bubbly mobile game controls. Large-shape graphic composition and bold typographic hierarchy, outstanding bespoke design with one memorable recurring silhouette: a split circular socket with a single vertical red index notch, used once in large madness dial and small in orb sockets. Use soft desaturated peach/vermillion tinted edge light, cool gray secondary light.
COMPOSITION, meticulously functional and readable: environment at upper/middle right, stylish intimidating original enemy "THE AUDITOR" a towering hollow figure in modern tailored overcoat, fragmented black obsidian face and angular crimson backlit slit, standing in a concrete metro-like soul-processing hall with modern elevators and distant red light, low scene saturation, atmospheric depth. No huge explosions, art must not rescue weak UI. Dominant lower foreground is a HIGHLY DESIGNED TYPING INSTRUMENT with three word choices physically integrated into a coherent sculpted control rail. Choose this as the signature hero of the screen.
Top left small "SECTOR 06 / ENCOUNTER 02". Enemy name upper center with segmented very slender HP channel "THE AUDITOR" "187 / 320". Beneath enemy a modest but clear red attack readout "HEAVY STRIKE / 3.2 s". Upper right tiny pause icon recessed into metal.
Left 23% sidebar is NOT a plain web-style panel: three overlapping offset portrait plates, clean repeating rhythm, precise crop of contemporary anime heroines in modern coats or streetwear with tactical agency insignia, beautiful but restrained: black-haired ALICE, pale short silver-blue-haired ELLEN, purple-haired LUNA. Each small portrait plate has 3 skill rows, two equipped plus one empty, coherent dark material, enough spacing. Names and skills clean readable sans serif: ALICE / Double Cut / Whirlwind / — ; ELLEN / Minor Heal / Renewal / — ; LUNA / Water / Meteor / —. Each skill has a small sequence of colored orb glyphs, no wall of fake microtext. Sidebar integrated by architecture and overlaps, not a giant shiny gold frame.
Lower center-right: EXACTLY THREE word units on the sculpted typing rail: left "ember", center active "verdict", right "hollow". Each has a small semantic colored orb glyph and minimal small category caption "FIRE", "WATER", "VOID". Active center has porcelain white face plate framed in black enamel edge, dark razor-sharp large true monospaced "verdict", first "ver" black and remaining "dict" muted gray, small underline cursor. This plate is slightly forward and casts a clear tight shadow on the chassis behind. Inactive left/right plates are smoked black glass, readable pale text, visibly seated 4px deeper. All text level and unwarped. A thin red index at active top edge. Avoid simple three card rectangles; unify them with one crafted chassis, seams, inset lip and spacing.
Below the rail five orb sockets with real depth: yellow cut gem, green cut gem, blue cut gem, two empty dark sockets. Small controlled emission only within gem, same coherent bevel and rim lighting. Main status bottom: ivory HP bar "PARTY HP 720 / 1000" left center, physically recessed with bright thin fill and trailing dark fill. Bottom right a large beautiful mechanically inspired madness dial, split-ring black glass gauge with finely engraved ticks and a purple internal arc, bold "680" and "/ 1000", title "MADNESS", and visible "DANGER". Number truly readable, not a giant speedometer swallowing half screen. Connect gauges to rail using shared materials, not random decorated boxes.
Quiet footer hints "ENTER  Reroll 3/3" "SPACE  Pause". Small notification near party "Minor Heal +83". Professionally kerned contemporary sans, real monospaced typing, no serif body, no fine print filler. Main typing letters at least 48px at 1920 width, avoid cramped lower band.
Critical: the polished crafted UI itself must convey expensive art direction even if the background were removed. Layered composition, convincing material treatment, purposeful lighting and typography, quiet areas, not just a screenshot of artwork with flat rectangle overlays. No fake title logo on screen. No decorative random pipes or bolts around everything. This is a DESIGN PROPOSAL, not functional game software.

Create a sophisticated JAPANESE UI ART DIRECTION SPECIFICATION BOARD, landscape 3:2 large high resolution, impeccable readable Japanese, exact orderly layout. Use attached battle screenshot as a MATERIAL AND DESIGN LANGUAGE reference only. Do not reproduce its characters, enemy or environment. This board must prove the UI quality comes from components, not dramatic background illustration. Title 「現代の地獄 / UI設計資料」 subtitle 「BLACK ENAMEL — デザイン提案 v0.2」. Editorial artbook presentation on warm gray background, charcoal component stages, restrained crimson numbering. Rich premium UI with tactile material, not flat web card design. Black semi-gloss enamel housings, subtle smoked recessed glass, thin titanium edge reflections, ivory ceramic active surfaces, restrained red index lamps. Reduce the battle reference's heavy mechanical armor by 40%: thin refined equipment, no giant metal struts, no unnecessary screws, no excessive abrasion, no medieval ornament, no Japanese motifs, no brass. One upper left light direction, realistic subtle contact shadows, microscopic bevels; largest type not metallic.
Organize into 6 clearly separated modules in 3 columns x 2 rows. Each module has a concise Japanese heading, LARGE actual component specimens, very few readable annotations.
01 「平面と、奥行きの違い」 paired same-sized buttons showing left plain flat gray rectangle 「続行」 labelled 「平面」, right premium crafted layered button 「続行」 labelled 「提案」. RIGHT has thin edge glint, small side wall, close contact shadow, opaque clean typing face. Four clear hairline callouts numbered to actual right button features: 「縁の反射」「面の段差」「接触影」「素材の差」. Do not call flat UI inherently bad; small note 「この作品では質感を選ぶ」.
02 「材質は3種類」 large tightly framed macro cropped swatches with their actual visible edges and material behavior: 黒い焼付塗装 / 広く弱い反射; スモークガラス / 奥に沈む表示面; 白い操作プレート / 主操作に限定. Show glass reflection only at edge, central text surface quiet. small light direction arrow upper left 「光源は上左」.
03 「ボタンの状態」 exactly 4 identical-size premium UI button specimens with captions 「通常」「フォーカス」「押下」「無効」. Button text English "CONTINUE" to demonstrate localization. Normal dark semi-gloss, focus ivory enamel active surface and little red index, pressed lower and shadow reduced with same readable text, disabled muted with lock and caption "Unavailable". Avoid glowing full perimeter. Small note 「色だけでなく、段差で反応」.
04 「テキストフレーム」 one substantial beautiful dark dialogue enclosure with subtle titanium lip outer chassis and recessed smoked glass central area, small protruding ivory name plate "ELLEN", Japanese body accurately 「まだ戻れる。」「ここで帰還して、記録を残そう。」. At bottom two elegant buttons 「帰還する」 primary ivory, 「先へ進む」 secondary black. Body looks clean 24px not calligraphy. tiny spec 「内側余白24 / 本文24 / 行間1.6」. No character art.
05 「入力欄を主役に」 actual substantial 3-slot typing rail isolated on neutral dark background with selected center "verdict" split typed "ver" black, remaining "dict" gray on ivory forward plate, inactive sides "ember" and "hollow" on deeply recessed black. Keep large Roman monospace readable. Beneath concise annotations 「選択面は手前」「待機面は奥」「文字に装飾を重ねない」. Craft fine precision housing not bulky battle armor.
06 「共通化する決まり」 actual small component strips: top row one source light direction and repeatable split-ring socket with red vertical index; middle three miniature glyphs showing neutral text / red warning / purple madness; bottom Japanese and English matching pairs 「拠点へ帰還」 / "Return to base" correctly fit same button height with flexible width. Short legible rule text 「形・光・材質を共有」「文字は画像に焼き込まない」「日英で幅を確認」.
Footer 「画像は完成像の提案。分割素材・フォント・状態演出は実装時に制作します。」.
Quality must be a professional UI designer's tactile game design sheet, not an infographic made of empty boxes, not a moodboard of metal textures. Precise uncluttered composition, large functional component demonstrations, exact readable labels. Do not add unrelated invented narrative copy.
